insight: Respect TA's refraction charges in lane. Without it, she cannot trade effectively. Avoid walking into positions where she can chain damage with multiple refraction hits.
Skip Tangos early and get Sage's Mask instead to spam Refraction. This is more efficient than healing charges when your support can provide additional healing.
Stand back from the rune area to maintain vision. If enemy approaches, you have time to retreat. Never contest runes against Centaur as he will stun you.
Identify creep balance: when you have more creeps than opponent, you can safely trade. Only engage enemies when they're in awkward positions relative to the wave.
Never miss last hits while pushing the wave. If hitting an enemy means missing creeps, don't do it. Farming efficiency takes priority over harass.
After pushing wave, farm hidden camps to deny enemy vision. Route through areas without ward coverage to avoid predictability.
Use Refraction proactively before engagements, not reactively. Always have a charge ready for escape. Losing charges to poor positioning is a critical mistake.
Change trajectory of Psi Blades after launching to save time. Align with creeps first minimally, then reposition mid-attack to farm faster.
Prioritize Desolator early for damage. Get mobility items like Blink and Tumbler for positioning. In late game, add BKB when enemies deal heavy magical damage.
Always use Refraction off cooldown in mid-game to maintain charges. Only hold it for critical moments when you need escape guarantees.
Place traps to cut enemy jungle rotation and farm camps. Put traps on high ground entrances before advancing to prevent ganks.
Avoid hitting Centaur and Spectre as they burn through Refraction quickly. Focus isolated soft supports like Jakiro when possible.
Use Tumbler actively for free repositioning during fights. Use Blink Dagger to burst isolated targets and escape before backup arrives.
Identify 2-3 second windows where you can attack isolated enemies. Know when enemies rotate so you stop fighting and escape before they arrive.
Stay near supports for healing. Use Pike and BKB to create space. Reposition continuously to avoid being focused. Always have an escape ready.
Always prioritize movement speed over damage in neutral item selection. Movement speed saves you from ganks and lets you farm more efficiently.
Stay with TA to heal her after trades. Your healing enables her to spam Refraction and harass safely without needing Tangos.
Duel isolated enemies to secure kills for your team. In late game with BKB, duel the most threatening enemy (like Spectre) to disable and burst them.
Use voice comms to call for objectives. If your team won't commit to a target objective, don't abandon them to farm alone - stay grouped to prevent picks.
Always maintain maximum range from enemies. Don't walk into unnecessary damage. Use mobility items to kite and escape rather than standing and fighting.
Farm areas without enemy vision to avoid getting caught. Always check minimap for missing enemies before leaving safe areas.
Focus on securing mega creeps and high ground to force game end. Don't let enemies have time to farm back into the game.
